description: Polyphonic LFO from Surge: seven waveforms with a delay-attack-hold-decay-sustain-release envelope over them, and tempo-sync on every time.

params.text: Sets the rate of the LFO, 0.0078Hz to 512Hz, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Picks the waveform: Sin, Tri, Sqr, Ramp, Noise, S&H or Env.
Sets the point in the waveform the LFO starts from when it is triggered, 0 to 100% of a cycle.
Bends the shape of the chosen waveform, 0 to 100%.
Chooses whether the output swings either side of 0V or stays above it.
Sets the delay between the gate opening and the envelope beginning to rise, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets how long the envelope stays at full after the attack before the decay starts, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the attack time of the envelope, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the decay time of the envelope, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the level the envelope holds while the gate stays high, 0 to 100%.
Sets the release time of the envelope, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Switches the LFO rate from Hz to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the envelope delay from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the envelope hold from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the envelope attack from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the envelope decay from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the envelope release from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.

inputs.text: A gate above 1V runs the envelope over the LFO and the number of channels here sets the polyphony; with nothing patched the LFO free-runs and the envelope holds at full sustain.
Adds to the Rate knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Phase knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Magnitude knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Deform knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Delay knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Hold knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Att knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Decay knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Sus knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Rel knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced rates and times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The LFO, about ±5V when the output is set to bi and 0V to 5V when it is set to uni, with one channel for each channel of the Gate input.

notes: the blue lamp is lit while something is patched into the Gate input, which is the only condition in which the envelope runs.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
